problem: The coefficient of ${u}^{3}$ in the expansion of ${(1-u)}^{20}$ is{{field-1}}.
worked_solution:
The binomial expansion for $(1+x)^{n}$ is given by

$$
(1+x)^{n}=1+nx+\frac{n(n-1)}{2!}{x}^{2}+⋯.
$$

In particular, the ${x}^{3}$ term is given by

$$
\frac{n(n-1)(n-2)}{3!}{x}^{3}.
$$

Replacing $x$ with $-u$ and $n$ with $20$ in the above expression, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{20(20-1)(20-2)}{3!}\cdot (-u)^{3} & =\frac{20\cdot 19\cdot 18}{6}\cdot (-u)^{3} \\  & =1140\cdot (-{u}^{3}) \\  & =-1140{u}^{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coefficient of ${u}^{3}$ is $-1140.$
